cn-20261105-news-1.title: October CPI and PPI to Be Released: How to Read the Price "Thermometer"? Who is Driving Food, Energy, and Core CPI

segments.src: ## 导读
segments.tr: ## Introduction

segments.src: 每个月,国家统计局都会公布一组备受关注的数据:居民消费价格指数(CPI)和工业生产者出厂价格指数(PPI)。10月份的物价数据即将发布,不少读者会关心:物价到底是涨了还是跌了?“通缩压力”有没有缓解?本文不预测具体数值,而是帮你掌握一套读数据的方法,在数据公布时能够看懂、看准。
segments.tr: Every month, the National Bureau of Statistics releases a set of closely watched data: the Consumer Price Index (CPI) and the Producer Price Index (PPI). With the October price data about to be released, many readers may wonder: have prices gone up or down? Has "deflationary pressure" eased? Instead of predicting specific figures, this article will help you master a set of methods for reading the data so that you can understand and accurately interpret it when the data is released.

segments.src: ## 一、CPI与PPI:两支不同的“温度计”
segments.tr: ## I. CPI and PPI: Two Different "Thermometers"

segments.src: **CPI(居民消费价格指数)** 衡量的是居民日常购买的一篮子商品和服务的价格变化,涵盖食品烟酒、衣着、居住、生活用品及服务、交通通信、教育文化娱乐、医疗保健等类别。它更接近普通家庭的“生活感受”。
segments.tr: **CPI (Consumer Price Index)** measures the price changes of a basket of goods and services purchased daily by residents, covering categories such as food, tobacco and alcohol, clothing, residence, household goods and services, transportation and communication, education, culture and entertainment, and healthcare. It is closer to the "living experience" of ordinary families.

segments.src: **PPI(工业生产者出厂价格指数)** 衡量的是工业企业出厂产品的价格变化,反映的是上游生产环节的价格走势。原油、煤炭、有色金属、钢材等大宗商品价格,会明显影响PPI。
segments.tr: **PPI (Producer Price Index)** measures the price changes of products leaving the factory gates of industrial enterprises, reflecting the price trends of the upstream production link. Prices of bulk commodities such as crude oil, coal, non-ferrous metals, and steel significantly affect the PPI.

segments.src: 简单理解:PPI偏“上游”,CPI偏“下游”。上游成本的变化,有时会经过一段时间传导到终端消费价格,但传导的幅度和速度并不固定,中间还受到企业议价能力、市场竞争程度和需求强弱的影响。
segments.tr: Simply put: PPI leans toward the "upstream," while CPI leans toward the "downstream." Changes in upstream costs sometimes transmit to terminal consumer prices after a period of time, but the magnitude and speed of transmission are not fixed and are also influenced by the bargaining power of enterprises, the degree of market competition, and the strength of demand.

segments.src: ## 二、同比与环比:两个必须分清的概念
segments.tr: ## II. Year-on-Year and Month-on-Month: Two Concepts That Must Be Distinguished

segments.src: - **同比**:本月与上年同月相比的变化。它能剔除季节性因素的影响,适合观察中长期趋势,但容易受到“基数效应”的干扰。
segments.tr: - **Year-on-Year (YoY)**: The change comparing the current month with the same month of the previous year. It eliminates the influence of seasonal factors and is suitable for observing medium- and long-term trends, but it is easily disturbed by the "base effect."

segments.src: - **环比**:本月与上月相比的变化。它反映短期波动,更适合捕捉最新的边际变化,但容易受到节假日、天气、季节等因素影响。
segments.tr: - **Month-on-Month (MoM)**: The change comparing the current month with the previous month. It reflects short-term fluctuations and is better suited for capturing the latest marginal changes, but it is easily affected by holidays, weather, seasons, and other factors.

segments.src: **基数效应**举个例子:如果去年同期价格处于高位,今年即便价格持平,同比也会显示下降;反之,如果去年同期价格较低,同比数据则会显得偏高。因此,看同比时,一定要结合上年同期的水平,以及环比走势一起判断。
segments.tr: Here is an example of the **base effect**: If prices were at a high level in the same period last year, the year-on-year figure will show a decline this year even if prices remain flat; conversely, if prices were lower in the same period last year, the year-on-year data will appear relatively high. Therefore, when looking at year-on-year figures, one must combine the level of the same period of the previous year with the month-on-month trend for judgment.

segments.src: ## 三、拉动CPI的三大变量
segments.tr: ## III. The Three Major Variables Driving CPI

segments.src: ### 1. 食品价格:猪肉与鲜菜的“天气账”
segments.tr: ### 1. Food Prices: The "Weather Account" of Pork and Fresh Vegetables

segments.src: 食品在CPI中占有相当比重,且波动较大。其中:
segments.tr: Food accounts for a considerable proportion of the CPI and fluctuates greatly. Among them:

segments.src: - **猪肉**:价格受生猪存栏、养殖周期和出栏节奏影响,存在较明显的周期性。猪肉价格同比的高低,常常会对CPI食品项产生显著影响。
segments.tr: - **Pork**: Prices are affected by live pig inventories, breeding cycles, and market release rhythms, showing a relatively obvious cyclicality. The level of year-on-year pork prices often has a significant impact on the CPI food item.

segments.src: - **鲜菜、鲜果**:受天气、产地、运输成本影响明显。秋季气温变化、降雨情况,都可能带来短期价格波动。
segments.tr: - **Fresh Vegetables and Fruits**: Significantly affected by weather, production areas, and transportation costs. Autumn temperature changes and rainfall may all bring short-term price fluctuations.

segments.src: - **节假日因素**:国庆长假前后,餐饮、出行相关的需求集中释放,部分食品价格也会出现阶段性变化。
segments.tr: - **Holiday Factors**: Around the National Day golden week, demands related to dining and travel are released centrally, and prices of some foods also show phased changes.

segments.src: 阅读数据时,可以留意统计局对“食品价格同比/环比”的分项说明,判断CPI的变化主要来自食品,还是来自其他类别。
segments.tr: When reading the data, you can pay attention to the National Bureau of Statistics' sub-item explanations on "food prices year-on-year/month-on-month" to determine whether changes in the CPI mainly come from food or other categories.

segments.src: ### 2. 能源价格:汽油、柴油与居民用能
segments.tr: ### 2. Energy Prices: Gasoline, Diesel, and Residential Energy

segments.src: 交通燃料(汽油、柴油)以及居民用水电燃气等,都属于CPI的组成部分。国际原油价格波动、国内成品油调价节奏,会影响交通和居住类价格。能源价格变化通常“来得快、去得也快”,在分析趋势时,不宜仅凭单月能源价格波动下结论。
segments.tr: Transportation fuels (gasoline, diesel), as well as residential water, electricity, and gas, are all components of the CPI. International crude oil price fluctuations and the pace of domestic refined oil price adjustments affect transportation and housing prices. Energy price changes usually "come fast and go fast," and when analyzing trends, it is inappropriate to draw conclusions based solely on single-month energy price fluctuations.

segments.src: ### 3. 服务价格:更稳定,也更能反映需求
segments.tr: ### 3. Service Prices: More Stable and Better Reflecting Demand

segments.src: 服务类价格包括旅游、餐饮、教育、医疗、家政、交通出行等。与食品、能源不同,服务价格波动相对平缓,但更能体现居民消费意愿和需求恢复情况。节假日期间,旅游、住宿、交通票价常常出现季节性上涨,需要结合环比与往年同期情况来看。
segments.tr: Service prices include tourism, catering, education, medical care, housekeeping, transportation, etc. Unlike food and energy, service price fluctuations are relatively smooth, but they better reflect residents' consumption willingness and demand recovery. During holidays, tourism, accommodation, and transportation ticket prices often experience seasonal increases, which need to be viewed in combination with month-on-month and previous years'同期 (same period) conditions.

segments.src: ## 四、核心CPI:剔除“噪音”后的价格信号
segments.tr: ## IV. Core CPI: Price Signals After Removing "Noise"

segments.src: **核心CPI**通常指扣除食品和能源价格后的CPI。由于食品和能源价格波动大、受供给冲击影响明显,剔除后的核心CPI能更好地反映总体需求和价格的基础趋势。
segments.tr: **Core CPI** generally refers to the CPI excluding food and energy prices. Because food and energy prices fluctuate greatly and are obviously affected by supply shocks, the core CPI after their exclusion can better reflect overall demand and the underlying trend of prices.

segments.src: 读数据时可以关注:
segments.tr: When reading the data, you can focus on:

segments.src: - 整体CPI与核心CPI的差距:如果整体CPI受猪肉等食品拖累,而核心CPI相对稳定,说明价格变化更多来自供给端和季节性因素。
segments.tr: - The gap between headline CPI and core CPI: If headline CPI is dragged down by foods like pork while core CPI remains relatively stable, it indicates that price changes come more from the supply side and seasonal factors.

segments.src: - 核心CPI的走势:如果核心CPI持续温和回升,往往意味着消费需求在改善;如果长期在低位徘徊,则说明需求端仍需观察。
segments.tr: - The trend of core CPI: If core CPI continues to rebound moderately, it often means that consumer demand is improving; if it lingers at a low level for a long time, it indicates that the demand side still needs to be observed.

segments.src: ## 五、PPI怎么读:工业品价格的“上游信号”
segments.tr: ## V. How to Read PPI: The "Upstream Signal" of Industrial Product Prices

segments.src: PPI的变化主要关注三点:
segments.tr: Changes in PPI mainly focus on three points:

segments.src: 1. **大宗商品价格**:原油、煤炭、有色金属、黑色金属的价格,是影响PPI的重要因素。
segments.tr: 1. **Bulk Commodity Prices**: The prices of crude oil, coal, non-ferrous metals, and ferrous metals are important factors affecting the PPI.

segments.src: 2. **同比与环比的背离**:有时PPI环比转正,但同比仍为负,这通常说明价格出现边际改善,但由于上年基数较高,同比数据修复需要时间。
segments.tr: 2. **Divergence Between Year-on-Year and Month-on-Month**: Sometimes the PPI turns positive month-on-month, but remains negative year-on-year. This usually indicates that prices have shown marginal improvement, but due to the high base of the previous year, year-on-year data repair takes time.

segments.src: 3. **生产资料与生活资料**:生产资料价格反映工业投入品的行情,生活资料价格则更接近消费端,两者的差异有助于观察价格传导情况。
segments.tr: 3. **Means of Production and Means of Livelihood**: Means of production prices reflect the market conditions of industrial inputs, while means of livelihood prices are closer to the consumption end. The difference between the two helps observe price transmission.

segments.src: ## 六、如何判断“通缩压力”是否缓解?
segments.tr: ## VI. How to Judge Whether "Deflationary Pressure" Is Easing?

segments.src: “通缩”通常指物价总水平在较长时间内持续下降,并伴随需求不足、企业利润承压等现象。仅凭一个月的数据,很难下结论。可以从以下几个角度综合观察:
segments.tr: "Deflation" usually refers to a continuous decline in the general price level over a relatively long period, accompanied by phenomena such as insufficient demand and corporate profit pressures. It is difficult to draw conclusions based on just one month of data. Comprehensive observations can be made from the following perspectives:

segments.src: - **看趋势,不看单月**:连续几个月的同比、环比方向是否改善,比单月数值更有参考价值。
segments.tr: - **Look at trends, not a single month**: Whether the direction of year-on-year and month-on-month for several consecutive months is improving is more reference value than single-month figures.

segments.src: - **看核心,不只看总数**:核心CPI是否企稳回升,比受猪肉影响的整体CPI更能反映需求。
segments.tr: - **Look at the core, not just the total**: Whether core CPI stabilizes and rebounds reflects demand better than headline CPI affected by pork.

segments.src: - **看上下游联动**:PPI的降幅是否收窄、环比是否回升,能否逐步传导到CPI。
segments.tr: - **Look at upstream and downstream linkages**: Whether the decline in PPI is narrowing and whether month-on-month is rebounding, and whether it can be gradually transmitted to CPI.

segments.src: - **看结构**:是普涨还是个别品种上涨?是供给因素,还是需求带动?
segments.tr: - **Look at structure**: Are prices rising across the board or only for individual varieties? Is it driven by supply factors or demand?

segments.src: - **结合其他指标**:社会消费品零售总额、工业增加值、就业与居民收入等数据,有助于更完整地理解物价变化背后的原因。
segments.tr: - **Combine with other indicators**: Data such as total retail sales of consumer goods, industrial added value, employment, and residents' income help to more completely understand the reasons behind price changes.

segments.src: ## 七、普通读者的实用建议
segments.tr: ## VII. Practical Advice for Ordinary Readers

segments.src: 1. **理性看待单月数据**:受天气、节假日、基数等影响,单月数据可能存在较大波动。
segments.tr: 1. **View single-month data rationally**: Affected by weather, holidays, bases, and other factors, single-month data may have large fluctuations.

segments.src: 2. **关注官方分项解读**:国家统计局在发布数据时会同步给出分项原因,是最权威的解读来源。
segments.tr: 2. **Pay attention to official sub-item interpretations**: The National Bureau of Statistics will simultaneously provide sub-item reasons when releasing data, which is the most authoritative source of interpretation.

segments.src: 3. **把物价与自身生活联系起来**:CPI是全国平均水平,个人感受到的物价变化可能与之不同,因为每个家庭的消费结构各不相同。
segments.tr: 3. **Connect prices with your own life**: CPI is a national average level, and the price changes felt by individuals may differ because every family's consumption structure is different.

segments.src: 4. **避免过度解读**:宏观数据只是帮助我们理解经济运行的参考,不应作为单一决策依据。
segments.tr: 4. **Avoid over-interpretation**: Macro data only serves as a reference to help us understand economic operations and should not be used as a single basis for decision-making.

segments.src: ## 结语
segments.tr: ## Conclusion

segments.src: CPI与PPI是观察经济运行的两支重要“温度计”。读懂同比与环比、分清食品与能源的短期扰动、关注核心CPI与PPI的传导变化,才能更准确地理解物价走势。10月数据公布后,不妨对照本文的思路,从趋势、结构和上下游联动三个维度综合判断。
segments.tr: CPI and PPI are two important "thermometers" for observing economic operations. Only by understanding year-on-year and month-on-month, distinguishing short-term disturbances in food and energy, and paying attention to the transmission changes of core CPI and PPI can we more accurately understand price trends. After the October data is released, you might as well compare it with the ideas in this article and make a comprehensive judgment from three dimensions: trend, structure, and upstream-downstream linkage.

segments.src: *声明:本文仅为经济知识普及与数据解读方法介绍,不构成任何投资或决策建议。具体数据请以国家统计局官方发布为准。*
segments.tr: *Disclaimer: This article is only for the popularization of economic knowledge and the introduction of data interpretation methods, and does not constitute any investment or decision-making advice. Please refer to the official releases of the National Bureau of Statistics for specific data.*

cn-20261105-news-3.title: October Import and Export Data Outlook: How Long Can Foreign Trade Resilience Last Amid High Base, Tariffs, and the 'Going Global' Shift?

segments.src: 海关总署即将公布10月进出口数据。在去年同期基数偏高、外部贸易环境变化以及企业加快拓展多元市场的背景下,这份成绩单备受关注。本文不预测具体数值,而是从出口市场结构和进口大宗商品价格两个角度,梳理影响外贸表现的主要变量,帮助读者理解数据背后的逻辑。
segments.tr: The General Administration of Customs will soon release the import and export data for October. Against the backdrop of a relatively high base in the same period last year, changing external trade environments, and enterprises accelerating the expansion of diversified markets, this report card has attracted much attention. This article does not predict specific figures, but rather examines the main variables affecting foreign trade performance from two perspectives: export market structure and imported commodity prices, helping readers understand the logic behind the data.

segments.src: > 说明:本文仅为信息梳理与一般性分析,不构成任何投资或决策建议。具体数据请以海关总署官方发布为准。
segments.tr: > Note: This article is for information consolidation and general analysis only, and does not constitute any investment or decision-making advice. Please refer to the official releases of the General Administration of Customs for specific data.

segments.src: ## 一、先看“基数”:同比数据为何需要谨慎解读
segments.tr: ## I. First, Look at the "Base": Why Year-on-Year Data Needs Cautious Interpretation

segments.src: 同比增速既取决于当期的实际贸易量,也取决于去年同期的基数。若去年10月的进出口规模较高,今年同期即便保持平稳,同比数字也可能显得偏弱;反之,低基数则会放大增幅。
segments.tr: Year-on-year growth rates depend on both actual trade volume in the current period and the base from the same period last year. If the import and export scale in October of last year was relatively high, even if the same period this year remains stable, the year-on-year figures may appear weak; conversely, a low base will amplify the growth rate.

segments.src: 此外,还有几个常被忽略的因素:
segments.tr: In addition, there are several frequently overlooked factors:

segments.src: - **工作日与节假日安排**:国庆假期的衔接方式会影响当月实际出货天数。
segments.tr: - **Workdays and Holiday Arrangements**: The scheduling of the National Guard/Golden Week holidays affects the actual shipping days of the month.

segments.src: - **价格与数量的区别**:以美元计价的贸易额,会同时受到商品价格和汇率变化的影响,并不完全等同于贸易“量”的变化。
segments.tr: - **Distinction Between Price and Quantity**: Trade volume denominated in US dollars is simultaneously affected by commodity prices and exchange rate fluctuations, and is not entirely equivalent to changes in trade "volume".

segments.src: - **月度波动**:单月数据容易受短期因素扰动,观察累计数据和多月趋势更有参考意义。
segments.tr: - **Monthly Fluctuations**: Single-month data is easily disturbed by short-term factors, and observing cumulative data and multi-month trends has more reference value.

segments.src: 因此,解读10月数据时,建议同时关注当月同比、环比以及前10个月的累计表现。
segments.tr: Therefore, when interpreting October data, it is recommended to simultaneously focus on the monthly year-on-year, month-on-month, and cumulative performance of the first 10 months.

segments.src: ## 二、出口结构:对美、对东盟、对欧洲各有看点
segments.tr: ## II. Export Structure: Distinct Highlights for the US, ASEAN, and Europe

segments.src: ### 1. 对美出口:关税约束下的调整
segments.tr: ### 1. Exports to the US: Adjustments Under Tariff Constraints

segments.src: 近两年,中美之间的关税政策调整成为影响双边贸易的重要因素。关税成本上升后,部分企业会通过调整报价、优化供应链布局或转向其他市场来应对。观察对美出口数据时,可以关注:
segments.tr: In the past two years, tariff policy adjustments between China and the US have become an important factor affecting bilateral trade. After tariff costs rise, some enterprises respond by adjusting quotations, optimizing supply chain layouts, or turning to other markets. When observing export data to the US, you can focus on:

segments.src: - 出口金额的同比变化是否趋于企稳;
segments.tr: - Whether the year-on-year change in export value tends to stabilize;

segments.src: - 不同品类(如机电产品、劳动密集型产品)之间的分化;
segments.tr: - Differentiation among different categories (such as mechanical and electrical products, labor-intensive products);

segments.src: - 是否存在“提前发货”或订单节奏调整带来的阶段性波动。
segments.tr: - Whether there are phased fluctuations brought about by "front-loading" shipments or order rhythm adjustments.

segments.src: ### 2. 对东盟出口:多元化的重要支点
segments.tr: ### 2. Exports to ASEAN: An Important Pivot for Diversification

segments.src: 东盟已成为我国重要的贸易伙伴之一。区域全面经济伙伴关系协定(RCEP)的实施,以及东盟自身制造业和基础设施建设需求的增长,为中间品、机械设备和消费品出口提供了空间。
segments.tr: ASEAN has become one of China's important trade partners. The implementation of the Regional Comprehensive Economic Partnership (RCEP), as well as the growth of ASEAN's own manufacturing and infrastructure construction demands, has provided space for the export of intermediate goods, machinery and equipment, and consumer goods.

segments.src: 需要注意的是,对东盟出口中有相当一部分是中间品,这些产品可能经加工后再出口至第三方市场。因此,对东盟出口的变化,也在一定程度上反映了全球产业链的联动关系。
segments.tr: It should be noted that a considerable part of exports to ASEAN consists of intermediate goods, which may be re-exported to third-party markets after processing. Therefore, changes in exports to ASEAN also reflect, to a certain extent, the linkage relationship of the global industrial chain.

segments.src: ### 3. 对欧出口:需求与竞争并存
segments.tr: ### 3. Exports to Europe: Coexistence of Demand and Competition

segments.src: 欧洲市场对新能源相关产品、机电设备和日用消费品有较大需求,但同时也面临经济增长偏缓、本地产业保护诉求上升、绿色与合规标准趋严等因素。对欧出口能否保持稳定,既取决于当地消费和投资的恢复程度,也取决于企业对相关标准与规则的适应能力。
segments.tr: The European market has strong demand for new energy-related products, electromechanical equipment, and daily consumer goods, but it also faces factors such as slowing economic growth, rising local industrial protection demands, and tightening green and compliance standards. Whether exports to Europe can remain stable depends both on the degree of recovery of local consumption and investment, and on enterprises' ability to adapt to relevant standards and rules.

segments.src: ## 三、“出海”转向:从卖产品到布局本地
segments.tr: ## III. The "Going Global" Shift: From Selling Products to Local Layout

segments.src: “出海”不再只是简单的产品出口。越来越多企业开始通过海外建厂、本地化运营、跨境电商和品牌建设等方式,深度参与国际市场。这种转向带来几方面变化:
segments.tr: "Going Global" is no longer just simple product export. More and more enterprises are deeply participating in the international market through ways such as building factories overseas, localized operations, cross-border e-commerce, and brand building. This shift brings several changes:

segments.src: 1. **市场更分散**:除传统发达市场外,中东、拉美、非洲和中亚等新兴市场的占比逐步提升。
segments.tr: 1. **More Dispersed Markets**:除了 traditional developed markets, the proportion of emerging markets such as the Middle East, Latin America, Africa, and Central Asia is gradually increasing.

segments.src: 2. **产品更高端**:自动化设备、新能源产品等附加值较高的品类,在出口中的重要性不断上升。
segments.tr: 2. **More High-End Products**: Categories with higher added value, such as automation equipment and new energy products, are constantly increasing in importance among exports.

segments.src: 3. **贸易路径更复杂**:部分产能向海外转移后,会带动零部件、设备等中间品出口,但成品直接出口的形态可能随之变化。
segments.tr: 3. **More Complex Trade Paths**: After some production capacity is transferred overseas, it will drive the export of intermediate goods such as parts and components and equipment, but the form of direct export of finished products may change accordingly.

segments.src: 这意味着,单看对某一个国家的出口增速,已难以全面反映外贸的整体韧性,需要结合整体市场结构来观察。
segments.tr: This means that looking solely at the export growth rate to a certain country is no longer sufficient to comprehensively reflect the overall resilience of foreign trade, and it needs to be observed in combination with the overall market structure.

segments.src: ## 四、进口端:大宗商品价格是关键变量
segments.tr: ## IV. Import Side: Commodity Prices Are a Key Variable

segments.src: 进口数据同样值得关注,尤其是原油、铁矿石、铜、大豆等大宗商品。
segments.tr: Import data is also worth noting, especially bulk commodities such as crude oil, iron ore, copper, and soybeans.

segments.src: - **价格效应**:国际大宗商品价格的涨跌,会直接影响进口金额。价格下行时,即使进口数量保持稳定,进口额也可能出现下降。
segments.tr: - **Price Effect**: The rise and fall of international bulk commodity prices will directly affect import values. When prices decline, even if import volumes remain stable, import values may also drop.

segments.src: - **数量效应**:进口量能够更直接地反映国内生产与消费需求,例如工业用原料的采购节奏、能源和粮食的储备安排等。
segments.tr: - **Quantity Effect**: Import volumes can more directly reflect domestic production and consumption demand, such as the procurement rhythm of industrial raw materials, and reserve arrangements for energy and food.

segments.src: - **结构变化**:高技术产品和关键零部件的进口变化,可以折射制造业升级与投资情绪。
segments.tr: - **Structural Changes**: Import changes in high-tech products and key components can reflect manufacturing upgrading and investment sentiment.

segments.src: 观察进口数据时,将“价”与“量”分开看,有助于判断内需的真实温度,避免被价格波动所误导。
segments.tr: When observing import data, separating "price" from "quantity" helps judge the true temperature of domestic demand and avoid being misled by price fluctuations.

segments.src: ## 五、外贸韧性:支撑与隐忧并存
segments.tr: ## V. Foreign Trade Resilience: Coexistence of Support and Hidden Worries

segments.src: **主要支撑:**
segments.tr: **Main Supports:**

segments.src: - 完整的产业体系和较强的供应链配套能力;
segments.tr: - A complete industrial system and strong supply chain supporting capabilities;

segments.src: - 市场多元化持续推进,对单一市场的依赖度下降;
segments.tr: - The continuous promotion of market diversification, and the decline in dependence on a single market;

segments.src: - 高附加值产品和新业态(如跨境电商)的贡献增加;
segments.tr: - The increased contribution of high value-added products and new business formats (such as cross-border e-commerce);

segments.src: - 稳外贸相关政策在融资、通关、出口信用保险等方面持续发力。
segments.tr: - Policies related to stabilizing foreign trade continuing to exert strength in financing, customs clearance, export credit insurance, etc.

segments.src: **主要隐忧:**
segments.tr: **Main Hidden Worries:**

segments.src: - 全球需求恢复力度存在不确定性;
segments.tr: - Uncertainties exist in the recovery strength of global demand;

segments.src: - 贸易摩擦与关税政策仍可能反复;
segments.tr: - Trade frictions and tariff policies may still recur;

segments.src: - 部分行业竞争加剧,企业利润空间承压;
segments.tr: - Intensified competition in some industries, and enterprise profit margins under pressure;

segments.src: - 汇率与国际航运成本的波动,可能影响企业接单与交付。
segments.tr: - Fluctuations in exchange rates and international shipping costs may affect enterprises' order-taking and delivery.

segments.src: ## 六、如何阅读即将公布的数据
segments.tr: ## VI. How to Read the Upcoming Data

segments.src: 面对海关总署的数据,建议读者抓住以下几个要点:
segments.tr: Facing the data from the General Administration of Customs, readers are advised to grasp the following key points:

segments.src: 1. 同时看**同比与环比**,并结合累计数据判断趋势;
segments.tr: 1. Look at **year-on-year and month-on-month** simultaneously, and combine cumulative data to judge trends;

segments.src: 2. 区分**价格因素与数量因素**,特别是在大宗商品进口上;
segments.tr: 2. Distinguish between **price factors and quantity factors**, especially in bulk commodity imports;

segments.src: 3. 关注**市场结构与产品结构**的变化,而非只看总量;
segments.tr: 3. Pay attention to changes in **market structure and product structure** rather than just looking at total volume;

segments.src: 4. 将数据与PMI新出口订单、港口吞吐量等高频指标交叉验证。
segments.tr: 4. Cross-verify the data with high-frequency indicators such as PMI new export orders and port throughput.

segments.src: ## 结语
segments.tr: ## Conclusion

segments.src: 外贸的“韧性”,并不是某一个月数据的好坏,而是在外部环境变化中持续调整、不断适应的能力。高基数、关税与“出海”转向,构成了当前外贸分析的三条主线。10月数据公布后,不妨结合上述框架,更全面地理解中国外贸的现状与走向。
segments.tr: The "resilience" of foreign trade is not about the goodness or badness of a single month's data, but the ability to continuously adjust and adapt amid changes in the external environment. The high base, tariffs, and the "going global" shift constitute the three main lines of current foreign trade analysis. After the October data is released, you might as well combine the above framework to more comprehensively understand the current status and trend of China's foreign trade.
